questions.q_en:
The following pie chart represents percentage wise distribution of total number of students in a class in five different groups.

Total number of students in the class = 1800

Out of the total number of students in Blue group, respective ratio of boys and girls is 3:2 and out of the total number of students in Green group, respective ratio of boys and girls is 4:3. Number of girls in Blue group is approximately what percent of the number of girls in Green group?
questions.solution_en:
Total number of students in Blue group = 25/100 x 1800

= 450

Number of girls in Blue group = 2/5 x 450 = 180

Total number of students in Green group = 28/100 x 1800

= 504

Number of girls in Green group = 3/7 x 504 = 216

Required percentage = 180/216 x 100

= 83.33%

= 83% approx.
questions.solution_hi:
Total number of students in Blue group = 25/100 x 1800

= 450

Number of girls in Blue group = 2/5 x 450 = 180

Total number of students in Green group = 28/100 x 1800

= 504

Number of girls in Green group = 3/7 x 504 = 216

Required percentage = 180/216 x 100

= 83.33%

= 83% approx.

questions.q_en:
Study the following information carefully and answer the related question.

Following pie-chart represents the data regarding percentage break-ups of number of viewers of news channel from different towns.

Viewers from town P and R together are approximately what percent less than viewers from town S and U together?
questions.solution_en:
Let total viewer = a

Viewers from town P and R together = (12 + 10)% of a = 0.22a

Viewers from town S and U together = (26 + 11)% of a = 0.37a

Difference = 0.37a - 0.22a = 0.15a

Percentage = (0.15a/0.37a) x 100 = 40% (approx.)
questions.solution_hi:

Viewers from town P and R together = (12 + 10)% of a = 0.22a

Difference = 0.37a - 0.22a = 0.15a

Percentage = (0.15a/0.37a) x 100 = 40% (approx.)

Following Pie-Chart shows the percentage of employees of a software company that use a particular language out of C, Java, Python, Ruby or JavaScript.

If the total number of Male employees is 7200 and Females comprise of 40% of the workforce, what is the difference between the number of employees that use Java and the number of employees that use C?
questions.solution_en:
Females comprise 40% of the workforce.

So, Males comprise 60% of the workforce.

Total number of employees = 7200*(100/60) = 12000

Required difference = 28% of 12000 - 12% of 12000

= 1920
questions.solution_hi:

The following pie chart shows the percentage break-up of total costs of some items on a shop. Total cost of all the items together is ₹8000.

If the cost of items G, H, I is increased by 10% and cost of items J, K, L and M is decreased by 10% in next year, then what is the total cost of all the items together in next year?
questions.solution_en:
Total cost of items G, H, I together in next year = 110% of [8000 * (19+25+8)%] = ₹4576

Total cost of items J, K, L and M together in next year = 90% of [8000 * (17+11+6+14)%] = ₹3456

Total cost of all the items together in next year = 4576 + 3456 = ₹8032

questions.q_en:
Directions: Study the following information carefully and answer the related questions.

Following pie-chart represents the percentage break-ups of total number of products manufactured by a company during the following year.

Total number of products manufactured from 2010-2015 = 15000

If total number of sold to unsold products in the company in 2012 are in the ratio 4: 1 respectively, then find the total sale of company in same year.
questions.solution_en:
Total number of products manufactured:

In 2010 = 20% of 15000 = 3000

In 2011 = 13% of 15000 = 1950

In 2012 = 27% of 15000 = 4050

In 2013 = 8% of 15000 = 1200

In 2014 = 22% of 15000 = 3300

In 2015 = 10% of 15000 = 1500

Total number of products manufactured in 2012 = 4050

Then, total sale of company in 2012 = 4050 x 4/5 = 3240

In 2010 = 20% of 15000 = 3000

In 2011 = 13% of 15000 = 1950

In 2012 = 27% of 15000 = 4050

In 2013 = 8% of 15000 = 1200

In 2014 = 22% of 15000 = 3300

In 2015 = 10% of 15000 = 1500

Total number of products manufactured in 2012 = 4050

Then, total sale of company in 2012 = 4050 x 4/5 = 3240

questions.q_en:
The given pie charts shows the distribution (degree wise) of teachers in government schools in six different villages.

Total number of teachers = 3600

If 2/5th of number of teachers in government schools in state B is primary teachers, and monthly salary of each primary teacher is Rs.29500, then what will be the total monthly salary of all the primary teachers together in state B?
questions.solution_en:
Total number of teachers in government schools in state B = 3600 * 72/360 = 720

Number of primary teachers in state B = 720 * 2/5 = 288

Total salary of all the primary teachers in state B = 288 * 29500 = Rs.8496000 = Rs.84.96 lakh
questions.solution_hi:
Total number of teachers in government schools in state B = 3600 * 72/360 = 720

Number of primary teachers in state B = 720 * 2/5 = 288

Total salary of all the primary teachers in state B = 288 * 29500 = Rs.8496000 = Rs.84.96 lakh

The following pie chart shows the percentage distribution of sales of a company in 6 consecutive years. Total sales in 6 years is 9 crores.

Total sales of company in 1998 is what percent of total sales of company in 2000 and 2003 together?

Required percentage = 1.8 * 100/2.25 = 80%
